title: MR-KEP Evidence Ledger Entry
description: One atomic, IMMUTABLE evidence entry in the append-only Evidence Ledger (P64). Records the full provenance and lifecycle of a single (entity, field) observation from one source. Complements schemas/evidence.schema.json (Sprint 1), which is the per-certified-fact rollup; this schema is the finer-grained ledger row that rollup is built from. Evidence-first: no field value exists without a ledger entry. No fabrication: absent data is null, never invented.

evidence_id.description: Deterministic ID = 'EV-' + first 16 hex of evidence_hash (see hash strategy). Immutable once written.

entity_id.description: Stable entity identifier (e.g. normalized whisky key or Malt Radar whisky_id like W001997). Never a fabricated id.

field_name.description: Canonical field (matches authority/field_rules.yaml), e.g. abv, region, nose, score.

field_value.description: The observed value AS EXTRACTED (pre- or post-normalization per normalization). null when the source did not state it (no fabrication).

normalization.description: Normalization applied (matches field_rules.yaml normalization key), or null if raw.

source_name.description: Concrete source identity. Reuses authority source_key or P62 source id, e.g. 'whiskyfun', 'SRC_011', 'SRC_012', 'SRC_013', 'producer_technical_sheet'.

source_url.description: Canonical URL of the evidence. For official_wayback this is the web.archive.org snapshot URL. null only for offline sources (e.g. book) that use citation instead.

source_citation.description: Offline citation when source_url is null (e.g. book title, author, page). Required if source_url is null.

extraction_method.description: Named method from the source profile (e.g. 'trigger_scan', 'structured_parse'). Declarative reference only; P64 writes no extractor.

selector.description: The exact locator used (CSS/XPath/regex/anchor/page-offset). Enables re-verification. null for offline sources.

selector_hash.description: SHA-256 of the normalized selector string (see hash strategy).

retrieval_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC time the evidence was retrieved. For official_wayback, the SNAPSHOT capture time, with live_retrieved_at in notes if relevant.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the retrieved raw content (page/section) the value came from.

snapshot_hash.description: SHA-256 of the stored snapshot artifact (e.g. archived HTML/PDF), if a snapshot was preserved.

retrieval_hash.description: SHA-256 binding retrieval context = hash(source_url|retrieval_timestamp|content_hash). Proves WHAT was fetched WHEN.

evidence_hash.description: SHA-256 identity of the whole entry (see hash strategy). evidence_id is derived from it. Self-referential field excluded from its own input.

confidence.description: Deterministic confidence per authority/confidence.yaml at time of writing.

authority_tier.description: Tier of source_class per authority layer.

merge_strategy.description: merge_policies.yaml key IF this entry participated in a merge (e.g. 'authority_wins', 'latest_expert_wins'). null for a lone observation.

certification_level.description: Maps to P63 certification paths: proposed=PROPOSED_NEEDS_CERT, certified=paths A/B, rejected=identity conflict etc.

certification_path.description: P63 certification_paths.md path that produced certification_level, if applicable.

review_status.description: Human-review state. Never auto-promoted past needs_review without human action.

provenance_state.description: Current lifecycle state (see provenance_model.md). Ledger is append-only: a state change is a NEW entry, never an in-place edit.

supersedes.description: evidence_id this entry supersedes, when provenance_state transitions produce a new row. Preserves the chain; the old entry is NOT deleted.

notes.description: Free-text audit note. Never used to store a fabricated value.

allOf.description: If source_url is null, a source_citation is required (offline source traceability).
